shots.action: Coffee tips over a keyboard. Ellis hits UNDO. Liquid pulls back into the mug in a physically coherent reverse motion. No title card.
Ellis watches the perfectly full mug, then Pact's quiet indicator. Facial reaction followed by an unhurried reply.
Phone shows an embarrassing sent message addressed to Boss: LOVE YOU. Ellis raises the remote.

dialogue.speaker: ELLIS
dialogue.text: Even that text to my boss?

shots.action: UNDO tapped. Phone shows MESSAGE UNSENT; a workplace card changes to APPLICATION REVOKED. Ellis freezes. The first clear payoff is fully visible before 15 seconds.

dialogue.speaker: PACT
dialogue.text: Text removed. Job application removed, too.

shots.framing: Repeated angle matched across time change
shots.action: Ellis slaps UNDO again. Jump cut: blinds close, clock rewinds, his clothing changes to pajamas, and an alarm goes off. Show the transformation as deliberate stepping on twos.
He stares at the remote. The cup hovers on the edge. Annoyed, Ellis addresses the remote itself.

dialogue.speaker: ELLIS
dialogue.text: Undo the dumbest decision I made today.

shots.action: Remote screen selects PURCHASE: UNDO REMOTE. The object disappears. Pact's indicator stays on (Pact is a separate smart-home system).

dialogue.speaker: PACT
dialogue.text: Your purchase of the remote has been reversed.

shots.action: Original coffee spill reappears, flowing across the keyboard. A phone notification from BOSS reads LOVE YOU TOO. Focus on the phone, then Ellis.
Ellis looks at the ruined keyboard, then at the phone. No music under the pause. Hard cut immediately after his line.
